title: Trigonal Bipyramidal Dy5 Cluster Exhibiting Slow Magnetic Relaxation

synthesis.procedure: DyCl3·5H2O (1.076 g, 3.0 mmol) and 1-aminocyclohexanecarboxylic acid (Acc, 0.072 g, 0.5 mmol) were dissolved in 8.0 mL of demineralized water. The solution was stirred at about 80 °C while freshly prepared aqueous NaOH (1.0 M) was added dropwise to the point of incipient but permanent precipitation. The mixture was maintained at reflux for another 2 h, then filtered while hot. Evaporation of the filtrate under ambient conditions within three months afforded block-shaped colorless crystals.

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 1.0 M aqueous, added dropwise to incipient permanent precipitation

synthesis.temperature: stirred at about 80 °C; reflux for 2 h; crystallization at ambient conditions
synthesis.time: reflux 2 h; crystallization within three months
synthesis.ph: NaOH added to the point of incipient but permanent precipitation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aqueous ligand-controlled hydrolysis; hot filtration; slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered while hot; evaporation of the filtrate under ambient conditions within three months gave 0.22 g of block-shaped colorless crystals

properties.summary: The Dy5 cluster shows χMT decreasing from 64.62 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K to 36.70 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K, Curie–Weiss behavior with a small negative θ, unsaturated anisotropic magnetization, and frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility below 10 K consistent with slow magnetic relaxation/SMM-like behavior; no χ″ peaks, so Ea and τ0 were estimated from a Debye-model ln(χ″/χ′) vs 1/T fit.

measurements.conditions: 2 K, Hdc = 1000 Oe; dc susceptibility measured 300–2 K

measurements.name: magnetization M
measurements.conditions: 2 K, 7 T; unsaturated; M vs H/T plots not superimposed

measurements.name: effective energy barrier Ea
measurements.conditions: zero-dc-field ac susceptibility, Hac = 3 Oe, 1–1500 Hz; Debye-model fit of ln(χ″/χ′) vs 1/T over 2.0–6.2 K

measurements.name: relaxation time prefactor τ0
measurements.conditions: same ac/Debye analysis as Ea; frequency-dependent χ″ below 10 K without peaks
